description: A deterministic smoke suite for validating paired Graph and Explorer agent runs before using a real GSC repository.

graph.description: Use codebase-memory-mcp graph tools for code discovery.
instructions: Use codebase-memory-mcp graph tools for code discovery and evidence.
Do not inspect repository files with shell search or direct file-reading tools.
Record every code-discovery tool name in each answer's tool_calls array.

explorer.description: Use ordinary text search and file reading without the graph.
instructions: Use ordinary text search and file-reading tools for code discovery.
Do not call any codebase-memory-mcp graph tool.
Record every code-discovery tool name in each answer's tool_calls array.

tasks.prompt: How many functions named ambiguous_target exist, and which files define them?
Starting at main(), identify the definitions reached by local_target() and FixtureAlias\helper::qualified_target(). Include the destination file for each call.
Retrieve local_target() exactly. Report its file, one-based start and end lines, and exact source text including the final newline.
What file does #include FixtureAlias\helper resolve to, and which module-resolution settings make that mapping possible?
Should the bare ambiguous_target() call in main() resolve to one function? Report the candidate count and candidate files.
